title: WildFly or JBoss error report disclosed in a response
description: The response is the Undertow error report served by WildFly or JBoss: the body names the application server or its Undertow subsystem and carries an Error Report section with the exception detail.
remediation: Deploy a custom error page and turn off the container's default error handling so the server does not render Undertow diagnostics to clients.
limitation: Two body markers. A page that mentions WildFly in documentation is not matched; the error report section must also be present.

observation.body: WildFly deployments set the error page in web.xml.
